summary: Create two independent utility modules (math-utils.ts and string-utils.ts) in src/ using Bun + TypeScript with strict typing and proper error handling.

Create two independent, self-contained TypeScript utility modules (src/math-utils.ts and src/string-utils.ts) in an existing Bun + TypeScript project. Each module exports four functions with JSDoc comments and strict type annotations. No config files or dependencies are modified.
